title: Pre-K Tuition Late Fees: Due Dates and Assessment at the Family Services Desk
content:
This page covers the monthly tuition late fee on a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, and the tool the Family Services desk uses to post it.

## Rule in force

Tuition is due by the type's tuition due day of the billing month or, for a month whose tuition charge posts after that day, the due-day number of days after the charge posts, and payments are applied to the oldest open charge first. When part of a month's tuition is still unpaid after the due day, one late fee for that billing month is assessed by the Family Services desk, no earlier than the type's late-fee offset (in days) after the due day, in the amount the board-approved late-fee schedule gives on the records as they stand on the day the fee is assessed.

The fee is booked on the enrollment's tuition account, dated the day it is posted, and raises the amount the household owes on that enrollment by the fee. The family sees the late fee on the enrollment's tuition statement for that billing month.

## Posting the fee: `post_prek_late_fee_f766f23b`

**Capability.** The tool books one late fee entry on a tuition-based Pre-K enrollment's tuition account for one billing month, dated today.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the support agent unlocks `post_prek_late_fee_f766f23b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `enrollment_id` | the reference number of the student's Pre-K enrollment record for the school year, as returned by the enrollment lookup for the household | text id |
| `billing_month` | the billing month whose tuition was paid late, exactly as the billing month shown on that month's tuition charge | YYYY-MM: four-digit year, hyphen, two-digit month |
| `amount` | the late fee to book | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half up to the cent before booking |

**Return.** On success, a one-line receipt beginning "Late fee posted:" gives the new ledger entry reference, the enrollment reference, the billing month (YYYY-MM), the amount booked (USD, two decimals) and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked because an argument did not meet its format: a billing month not written YYYY-MM, or an amount that is not a positive USD amount.

## Illustration of the call (hypothetical values)

A call with `enrollment_id` set to a hypothetical reference "ENR-EXAMPLE", `billing_month` "2031-02" and `amount` 12.345 books 12.35, because the tool rounds half up to the cent, and returns a receipt beginning "Late fee posted:". A call with `billing_month` "Feb 2031" books nothing and returns a receipt beginning "Error:".
